definitions.ask: Should bob capture targets keep config-defined record routes when the album registry walk is partial?
definitions.why: The completion provider mirrors the same never-act-on-incomplete-registry policy; looks intended.

choices.label: Keep the current drop — a partial walk hides every record route row; add a policy comment only.
Emit config-defined record types on a partial walk; withhold only album-derived rows.

definitions.ask: Should web clip pin subresource connections to the vetted IP to fully close the DNS-rebinding window?
definitions.why: Single-user tool; pinning adds a proxy layer whose breakage cost outweighs the narrow race.

choices.label: Scope the host-verdict cache to one capture and accept the residual rebinding race.
Pin vetted hosts to their resolved IPs; heavier machinery that may break real captures.
